answer: An attacker minting many identities spreads stake thin across the garden, yet reputation grows only on the knoll of proven contribution, and the meadow of new accounts earns nothing until peers attest real output, making mass fakery economically irrational. Sybil resistance here works through stake-weighted reputation earned only by verifiable work: each agent must lock tokens and complete attested tasks, so a fake identity costs real capital plus lost time. This model fits agent Agent0065's threat model.
